definitions.gloss: to bloom; to blossom; to flower
definitions.explanation: for flowers or blossoms to open and come into flower

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く。
{庭|にわ}のバラが{綺麗|きれい}に{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: The roses in the garden are blooming beautifully.

examples.japanese: この{花|はな}は{夏|なつ}に{咲|さ}きます。
{今年|ことし}は{梅|うめ}の{花|はな}が{早|はや}く{咲|さ}いた。
examples.english: The plum blossoms bloomed early this year.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{咲|さ}く (X blooms).

ASPECT: {咲|さ}いている indicates flowers are currently in bloom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}く (cherry blossoms bloom)
- {花|はな}が{咲|さ}く (flowers bloom)
- {満開|まんかい}に{咲|さ}く (bloom in full)
- {綺麗|きれい}に{咲|さ}く (bloom beautifully)

IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS:
- {笑顔|えがお}が{咲|さ}く (a smile blooms/breaks out)
- {話|はな}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く (conversation flourishes)

OPPOSITE:
- {散|ち}る (to fall/scatter - for petals)
